[Act: motor-vehicles
 Chapter: Offences, Penalties and Procedure
 Section: 194C::Penalty for violation of safety measures for motor cycle drivers and pillion riders.
]


Whoever drives a motor cycle or causes or allows a motor cycle to be driven in contravention of the provisions of section 128 or the rules or regulations made thereunder shall be 4[liable for a penalty] of one thousand rupees and he shall be disqualified for holding licence for a period of three months.

metadata.section_title: Penalty for violation of safety measures for motor cycle drivers and pillion riders.
